tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyun khyer gyi bsangs yig bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bsangs rdzas ci 'byor ba chab kyis bran te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis skyabs sems byas la/ oṃ chos nyid mi 'gyur rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /dkon mchog thugs rjes bdag gi mos pa yis/ /bsangs mchod sna tshogs bshams shing sprul pa rnams/ /mkha' dbyings khyab pa dus kun 'byung ba dag /rang rang mos pa bzhin du spyod gyur cig /nyams grib sel ba'i dri zhim bsangs mchod 'dis/ /lung rtogs bstan pa gang la rag las pas/ /rtsa brgyud 'dren pa'i bla ma thams cad bsangs/ /yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems bsangs/ /bstan srung nor lha dkar phyogs thams cad bsangs/ /khyad par yul 'dir gnas pa'i yul lha bsangs/ /rang dang grogs la 'go ba'i lha rnams bsangs/ /mgon skyabs byed dang lam la gnas pa bsangs/ /mdor na 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig 'tshal/ /snang srid skye 'gro yod do cog kun bsangs/ /de ltar bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin gyis mthus/ /bdag cag bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /mi la na tsha phyugs la god ma btang / /legs pa'i gzhi things nyes pa'i phyogs las srungs/ /rkyen dbang phan tshun 'dzer 'phog byung ba rnams/ /mkha' la sprin dengs bzhin du bzod par gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /'dir mtshon rnam dkar dge tshogs kun gyi mthus/ /tshogs spel bgegs sel 'dod don kun 'grub pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyun khyer gyis bsangs yig bsdus pa 'di'ang sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ /dge'o zhal gro/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ rgyun khyer gyi bsangs yig bsdus pa la/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
